text:
Situation: Fluorouracil 50 mg/mL 20 mL vials are not on the FDA drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East holds 52 vials (18.3 days on hand) and Corvale General holds 56 vials (20.3 days on hand) at current use rates.

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list does not include fluorouracil as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Current inventory covers approximately three weeks of use. No national shortage is declared, but supply continuity should be secured before stock falls below two weeks.

Recommended actions:
1. Place a replenishment order with Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC (ranked option 1) — buyer to execute, pharmacy director to approve.
2. Qualify Heritage Pharmaceuticals Inc. d/b/a Avet Pharmaceuticals Inc. (ranked option 2) as a secondary source — buyer to execute, pharmacy director to approve.
3. Qualify ProPharma Distribution (ranked option 3) as a tertiary source — buyer to execute, pharmacy director to approve.
4. Monitor inventory weekly and report days on hand to the P&T committee at the next meeting — buyer to execute, committee chair to acknowledge.

Not recommended: No allocation, rationing, or therapeutic substitution at this time.
